title: AW-7C child chain P2..CERT claimed closed by the parent but has no closure rows or SHAs; supporting docs still show READY FOR AUDIT

impact: Roadmap L1989 says the AW-7C parent cert covers a child lineage "P0-3B + P1-ARCH + P2-CERT", but the ledger has rows only for P0-3B(+PHYSQ), P1-ARCH and CLOSURE-R1 and L1985 says AW-7C-P2 is next / not entered; the qualification and architecture records still show P2/P3/P4/CERT as READY FOR AUDIT. Not verified whether 2fab207f subsumes them.
recommendation: Owner to add closure rows (or an explicit subsumption statement with SHAs) for AW-7C-P2..CERT, and refresh the stale READY FOR AUDIT headers; Campaign B may check whether 2fab207f contains the P2-CERT test gates.

title: Roadmap-declared FRZ closing links for older stages are not reflected in the FRZ checklist rows
evidence: E1:A1 alpha1 mechanical check: for each linked FRZ ID the checklist row was searched for the stage ID as a whole token; 0 of 12 matched for the listed stages, while EBH-3, EBH-4, INT-CONFIG-REAL-X-CERT and AW-7C-P1-ARCH matched 12/12 or fully
impact: The roadmap maps 12 FRZ-BND/CTR/EXE links to these stages, but the FRZ rows never name the stage, so criterion status cannot be traced to stage closure by ID. This may only be a naming convention (family-level references); not established.
